demos.name: Nepal Flash Flood Digital Twin
demos.summary: Explore the August 2026 Himalayan flash flood in 3D and test downstream what-if scenarios across terrain, infrastructure and settlements.
demos.description: A standalone public 3D digital twin and what-if scenario lab for the Bhote Koshi / Trishuli corridor in Nepal. Visitors can replay the August 26 reference reconstruction, adjust 2-5 Mm3 barrier-lake assumptions, inspect modeled infrastructure exposure, compare scenarios, and review provenance, licensing and limitations.
demos.dataProvenance: Real Nepal corridor geography, runtime Cesium terrain, OpenStreetMap/HOT context, and representative synthetic scenario outputs. Geopera and Planet Source Cooperative are cited; non-commercial imagery/model products are not bundled.
demos.title: Nepal 2026 Flash Flood - 3D Digital Twin & What-If Scenario Lab
